title: Together Miniseries #2: The Death of External Power
fullTitle: Soul Feast #32: Together Miniseries #2: The Death of External Power
description: In this Soul Feast Gary continues the Together Miniseries by exploring one of the most defining shifts of our time: the death of external power. He explains how the structures that once defined success—control, dominance, manipulation—are no longer sustainable in the new consciousness that is emerging.
At the heart of this conversation is a powerful realization: the pursuit of external power, once necessary for our survival, now leads only to destruction—internally and collectively.

Gary examines how this outdated mode of power is still embedded in our institutions, relationships, and fears, and why it is now incapable of guiding us forward. Through compelling metaphors and deeply reflective insights, he challenges listeners to notice how fear masquerades as control and how our collective suffering stems from this dying model .
The path forward, Gary says, lies in creating authentic power: aligning your personality with your soul.
Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.
(01:12) — Why the old definition of power—manipulation and control—is now obsolete and dangerous
(05:20) — The metaphor of the steam engine and what it reveals about the end of external power
(08:58) — How the fuel of our old society—external power—has run out, and what’s replacing it
(13:10) — What authentic power looks like and how it differs from external power
(15:48) — How fear-based leadership fuels destruction and the role of the law of attraction in global events
(18:40) — Why change must come from within, not from trying to fix the world externally

Between now and the next episode, take time to journal about the external sources of power you may still be seeking—whether through achievements, influence, appearance, or control. Ask yourself: What fear is driving this desire? How might I respond differently if I were choosing from love instead of fear? This week, challenge yourself to take one small action that reflects the intentions of your soul—harmony, cooperation, sharing, and reverence for life.
